notes: This is not a copy of luci-ssl ACL grants. no_ubusauth skips uh_ubus_allowed; it does not add ACL rows.
Unauthenticated luci-ssl ACLs still name only luci.getFeatures. That ACL is not consulted at this HTTP gate.
cgi-io and dispatcher admin/ubus are not this profile. Root * remains intended_access (root-administration), not authorization_violation.
Skip-allows are unassessed HTTP-gate facts, not path_found and not invented luci-ssl grants.

intended_access.note: uhttpd JSON-RPC method call proceeds without session.access when option no_ubusauth 1 / uhttpd -a. This is the modeled config, not an ACL grant.

denied_authority: luci-ssl ACL grant for methods unauthenticated does not name
expectations.rationale: Pinned uhttpd ubus.c calls uh_ubus_allowed only when !conf.ubus_noauth. Stock luci-ssl-25.12 leaves the UCI option commented at 0. Enabling it is a distinct profile. Unauthenticated deny on luci-ssl-25.12 stays deny; this variant allows at the HTTP gate because the check is skipped.
review_provenance: openwrt/uhttpd@93b05e0b65d91c23c5aa8fdde378df1f174ec71d ubus.c parse_call_params SID rewrite and uh_ubus_handle_request_object skip of uh_ubus_allowed
